context_for_next_testing_agent: Team Task System fully implemented and tested. All features working: 1) TaskNotificationBar shows at top of every page with unassigned/assigned task counts (red when unassigned, green when all assigned). 2) TasksPage at /tasks with filter tabs (Actief/Voltooid/Alle), create task dialog, task cards with assign/complete/delete buttons. 3) Backend endpoints: GET /api/team-tasks, GET /api/team-tasks/unassigned, GET /api/team-tasks/my, GET /api/team-members, POST /api/team-tasks, PUT /api/team-tasks/{id}/assign, PUT /api/team-tasks/{id}/complete, DELETE /api/team-tasks/{id}. 4) All 8 task types supported: nieuwe_lead, eerste_bezoek, offerte_maken, materiaal_bestellen, planning, opvolging, administratie, overig. 5) Navigation menu has 'Taken' item linking to /tasks. 6) Email notification via Resend is implemented but not tested (preview environment limitation).

Admin Login.details: POST /api/auth2/login works with Liam/Liammail123, returns token and user

GET /api/team-tasks.details: Returns list of all tasks for admin

GET /api/team-tasks/my.details: Returns tasks assigned to current user

GET /api/team-members.details: Returns team members with id, name, email, role

POST /api/team-tasks.details: Creates new task with title, description, task_type

PUT /api/team-tasks/{id}/assign.details: Assigns task to team member, updates status to 'assigned'

PUT /api/team-tasks/{id}/complete.details: Marks task as completed with completed_at timestamp

All Task Types.details: All 8 task types (nieuwe_lead, eerste_bezoek, offerte_maken, materiaal_bestellen, planning, opvolging, administratie, overig) create successfully

TaskNotificationBar.details: Visible on dashboard and tasks page, shows task counts, expandable with task list

TasksPage Filter Tabs.details: Actief/Voltooid/Alle tabs filter tasks correctly with counts

Create Task Dialog.details: Opens with title, type, description, assign, project fields

Task Assignment UI.details: Assign dropdown works, shows toast 'Taak toegewezen!'

Task Completion UI.details: Voltooid button works, task moves to completed filter
